summary: Takes droplet scRNA-seq from Cell Ranger count matrices to a defended biological answer: ambient-RNA removal on the raw matrix, per-sample MAD-adaptive QC and doublet calling before any merge, batch integration scored on both axes, resolution-swept clustering that is never reported as proof of a cell type, reference and marker-based annotation with a rejection bin, and then the two cross-condition questions asked correctly and separately - pseudobulk DE with the biological sample as the unit of replication, and simplex-aware differential abundance. Droplet scRNA-seq only; not spatial. Research use only.

skills.description: Owns the ordering that makes or breaks the result: correct-then-detect-then-normalize, demultiplex hashed pools first, per-sample QC and doublets before merge, integrate then cluster then annotate, and pair pseudobulk DE with a differential-abundance test. Hands mechanism to the component Skills.
